name: mcp-cloud-deploy
description: Deploy static websites and single-page apps to Cloudflare Pages from chat.

interface.longDescription:
MCP Cloud Deploy publishes static websites and client-rendered single-page apps (React, Vite, Vue, Svelte and similar) to Cloudflare Pages from a conversation.

What it does:
- Deploys prebuilt output (dist, build, out) from a public GitHub repository to a Cloudflare Pages project, creating the project when needed and preserving nested images, fonts, CSS and JavaScript.
- Enables SPA fallback so client-side routes work.
- Attaches a custom domain you own and creates the CNAME automatically when the DNS zone is in the same Cloudflare account; otherwise it returns the exact record to add at your DNS provider.
- Lists recent deployments, URLs and domain bindings.

Who it is for: developers, designers and small businesses who want a site live on a free pages.dev address in minutes.

Authentication: OAuth. On the consent page you enter your own Cloudflare Account ID and a scoped API token (Cloudflare Pages Edit; Zone Read and DNS Edit only for automatic DNS). Credentials are encrypted with AES-256-GCM before storage and never returned in tool output.

Limitations: the hosted service does not run build scripts, so the repository must be public and already contain the built output. It does not host server-side rendering or backend APIs. Limits: 20 MiB compressed archive, 50 MiB extracted output, 10 MiB per file, 20,000 files.
defaultPrompt: Deploy the dist folder of my public GitHub repo to Cloudflare Pages as mystore
Attach www.example.com to my Pages project mystore
List my recent Cloudflare Pages deployments
